parameters.code: if (UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Stop Play before changing the spawn."); var scene = UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene(); if (scene.path != "Assets/Scenes/Garden_Moves.unity" || scene.isDirty) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Expected the clean Garden_Moves scene."); var rig = UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<OVRCameraRig>(); UnityEditor.Undo.RecordObject(rig.transform, "Move garden player closer to table"); var position = rig.transform.position; position.z = -3.6f; rig.transform.position = position; UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene); if (!UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene)) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Could not save the spawn."); return rig.transform.position.ToString("F3");
